entities.name: Vesuva

entities.name: Omo

entities.name: Helm of the Host
entities.description: Legendary helm made of Rathi flowstone specially for Omo.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: Event after which Vesuva was rebuilt.

events.summary: After the Great Mending, Vesuva is rebuilt and ruled by queen Omo.
